stories.title: The small intestine microbiome: composition, host interactions and therapeutic potential
stories.takeaway: Synthesizes small-intestinal microbial ecology, host interactions and therapeutic opportunities.
stories.what_happened: Review of human small-intestine sampling, microbial composition and host-interaction literature.
stories.why_it_matters: Clarifies why stool-based observations cannot automatically represent the small bowel.
stories.caveat: Review, not a new interventional trial.

stories.title: Flow-dependent TGF-β1 secretion from HCT116 cells following constriction-based microfluidic passage
stories.takeaway: Investigates how microfluidic constriction and flow affect TGF-β1 release from HCT116 colorectal cells.
stories.what_happened: Microfluidic constriction passage and TGF-β1/bioactivity measurements.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows why cell handling mechanics can alter biological assay readouts.
stories.caveat: Cell-line passage is not equivalent to intact intestinal tissue physiology.

stories.title: Microplastics inhibit macrophage bioenergetics impairing homeostatic function and immune responsiveness
stories.takeaway: Examines how microplastic exposure changes pulmonary macrophage energy metabolism and immune responsiveness.
stories.what_happened: Experimental microplastic exposure and macrophage bioenergetic/immune assays.
stories.why_it_matters: Illustrates mechanistic links between environmental exposure and immune-cell metabolism.
stories.caveat: Experimental exposures may not represent typical human exposure.

stories.title: The FMR1 isoform landscape reveals new spliced variants in women’s blood and ovarian tissues
stories.takeaway: Reports alternative FMR1 transcript isoforms in blood and ovarian tissue.
stories.why_it_matters: Demonstrates why transcript-level resolution matters beyond gene counts.
stories.caveat: Tissue-specific observations do not imply established functional effects.

stories.title: An AI-powered trisomy 21 Research Assistant
stories.takeaway: Introduces a literature-focused retrieval-augmented research assistant for trisomy 21.
stories.what_happened: Biomedical literature retrieval and language-model answer generation.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to traceable evidence synthesis across fast-moving biomedical literature.
stories.caveat: Automated answers require independent primary-source verification.
